- Handoff or block rule:

- Readiness audit:

  - Have access to code and test framework logs.

5. Run lint, typecheck, and focused test repeatedly until stable.

I will prepare the detailed diagnostic plan and patch proposal next. Confirm the file path or test suite name if you want to provide it, or I proceed with heap-based search on flaky OAuth refresh tests found in the repo and logs.
